name: Williston Basin onshore production, monthly per facility
description: Facility-level monthly production for the production-williston layer: every well the state files reported in the trailing 120 months, with surface coordinates, current, prior and last-year readings, a ten-year summary, field and county clusters, and on-demand history shards. Current = the newest complete filing month, by rule.
license_note: Public record of the North Dakota Industrial Commission; no licence text, state disclaimer applies

shards.note: Built alongside the index from the archived workbooks (O1, option a); a checkout without them shows the index and says so in the dossier.

eia.name: gross
eia.description: North Dakota Natural Gas Gross Withdrawals (MMcf)

eia.name: marketed
eia.description: North Dakota Natural Gas Marketed Production (MMcf)

eia.name: oil
eia.description: North Dakota Field Production of Crude Oil (Thousand Barrels)

completeness.rule: newest month whose count of facilities that filed is at least the threshold share of the median over the preceding lookback of months, that median being at least the floor share of the median over the lookback before it
completeness.reporterRule: wells present in the month’s workbook (filed a report)

reconciliation.note: State filings are gross gas at the wellhead as reported by operators; EIA gross withdrawals include estimates for wells the state file omits (confidential wells, late filers), marketed production excludes gas flared, vented and used for repressuring. Region totals exclude nothing the files carry.

assumptions.datum: NAD83 (assumed; the workbook does not state a datum)
assumptions.transform: none — NAD83 and WGS84 agree within a metre in North Dakota
assumptions.reporterRule: wells present in the month’s workbook (filed a report)
assumptions.finality: workbooks are final as published; late filings reach the PDF report only

anomalies: ND 2026-07: ReportDate column reads 2023-07-01 in a file named for 2026-07; the file name is taken as the month
ND 78,550 numeric cells hold text (NR/NA) across 120 months (155 to 1140 a month) and are read as not filed, never as zero

reproduce.raw_archive: Every workbook is archived verbatim under .gev-cache/onshore/<state>/ (git-ignored) with a .retrieved sidecar; parsed rows are cached beside it keyed by sha256; --replay rebuilds from the archive, --check diffs against the committed bytes.
